tasks.label: core-api
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; Get-Content deploy/.env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\w+=' } | ForEach-Object { $name, $value = $_ -split '=', 2; $value = $value.Trim(); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') }; go run github.com/NotReptile/RuCord/services/core-api/cmd/core-api

tasks.label: realtime
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8090 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} }; Get-Content deploy/.env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\w+=' } | ForEach-Object { $name, $value = $_ -split '=', 2; $value = $value.Trim(); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') }; go run github.com/NotReptile/RuCord/services/realtime/cmd/realtime

tasks.label: worker
tasks.command: Get-Content deploy/.env | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\w+=' } | ForEach-Object { $name, $value = $_ -split '=', 2; $value = $value.Trim(); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable($name, $value, 'Process') }; go run github.com/NotReptile/RuCord/services/worker/cmd/worker

tasks.label: frontend
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1420 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "freed port 1420 (pid $_)" } catch {} }; Set-Location apps/desktop; npm run dev

tasks.label: Stop All
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1420,8080,8090 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "killed pid $_ (port)" } catch {} }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'go.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'services[\\/]worker' } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "killed worker go pid $($_.ProcessId)" } catch {} }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'worker.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -match 'go-build' } | ForEach-Object { try { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "killed worker exe pid $($_.ProcessId)" } catch {} }
